notes: Funding is excluded from every feature set and is applied only to realized target and ledger P&L.
Normalized PostgreSQL analytics rows are excluded because the source audit found an unsafe child index and a slippage gap.
Gross one-hour targets use linear-contract arithmetic returns relative to entry notional.
Execution costs use the last order-book analytics observation in the completed 15-minute bucket at each simulated fill; exact boundary fills would require finer 1-minute or L2 data.
Contract metadata verifies flexible_futures BTC/USD, tick size 1, and the configured 5.0 bps MTF Linear Rebate Fees base taker fee.
Funding archive coverage begins at 2026-02-12 13:00:00+00:00; earlier missing rates are treated as zero and this limitation is not used as a model feature.
Full-range deterministic features are materialized once, but holdout rows are excluded from model fitting, calibration, policy selection, and development evaluation.
Every selected-fold calibration policy resolved to no-trade because no candidate with at least 50 trades had a positive 80% block-bootstrap lower bound.
objective: Qualify a reproducible PF_XBTUSD one-hour net edge using classical machine learning.

selection_protocol.feature_set: lowest mean walk-forward calibrated multiclass log loss
selection_protocol.model: lowest mean walk-forward calibrated multiclass log loss
selection_protocol.policy: chronological prior-month threshold search with a positive 80% circular-block bootstrap lower bound
